title: Position DaemonCore as infrastructure (not a tool/framework) with clear boundaries
description: Add a short section that reinforces category boundaries: DaemonCore is not a chatbot, not an orchestrator, not a prompt pack. It is governance infrastructure that defines what counts as a valid action and enforces boundaries beneath orchestration.
acceptance_criteria: Category boundaries are stated plainly and consistently with existing pages.
Does not duplicate FAQ verbatim; complements it.
